statement.text: Every Dirichlet L-function is nonzero to the right of one half, excluding the principal-character point at one.
Nonvanishing in the open right half-plane for every positive level, subject to the exception at one.
A Dirichlet L-function zero in the open critical strip has real part one half.
Every nontrivial zeta zero distinct from one lies on the critical line.
At positive real part the prime-power term has norm less than one, so a deleted Euler factor cannot vanish.

data.title: Pass a zero to the primitive character

statement.text: Change level to the conductor and rule out zeros of the deleted Euler factors.

data.name: Claim.prim_zero

statement.text: Both possible archimedean factors are nonzero at positive real part.
The completed functional equation transfers a primitive zero to the inverse character at one minus the original argument.

data.title: All Dirichlet zeros in the strip

statement.text: Use half-plane nonvanishing on the right. On the left, pass to the primitive character and reflect its zero to the right.

data.name: Claim.strip

statement.text: Use the level-one character in the strip and the zeta functional equation and nonvanishing outside it.
Right-half-plane nonvanishing implies RH by the zeta functional equation, with the exceptional gamma and trigonometric factors handled explicitly.

statement.text: Compute the gamma factor according to character parity on the positive half-plane.
